# Christian Beth

> PhD candidate in Computer Science at Kiel University, Germany, researching
> semantics-aware knowledge discovery from heterogeneous information networks (HINs).

Christian Beth works with Prof. Dr. Matthias Renz in the Archaeoinformatics -
Data Science Group, Department of Computer Science, Kiel University. His
research spans textual, spatial, and networked data, focused on
semantics-aware processing of semi-structured data. His current focus is
heterogeneous information networks: graphs where both nodes and edges carry
semantic type information, and he develops scalable algorithms for
similarity search and structural pattern mining. He completed his M.Sc. at
Kiel University in 2020 on high-pass graph filters for oversmoothing in deep
graph neural networks.

Keywords: knowledge discovery, semi-structured data, pattern mining,
heterogeneous information networks, spatio-temporal data, similarity search,
index structures.

Languages: German, Norwegian, English.
